q: Can a factory own a battery energy storage system and lease its capacity to others in India?
title: Battery storage owned by a consumer
short: Yes. The Electricity (Amendment) Rules, 2025 let a consumer develop, own, lease or operate an energy storage system. A battery owned by and co-located with the consumer takes the consumer's legal status. Its owner may sell, lease or rent storage capacity to any consumer, utility, load despatch centre or other person.
audience: Factories considering a battery at their own site or at another location

ul: Consumers were added to the list of who may develop, own, lease or operate an energy storage system, alongside generators, licensees, system operators and independent storage providers.
An energy storage system owned, operated and co-located with a consumer has the same legal status as that consumer.
If the consumer owns it but it is not co-located, it keeps the owner's legal status, but for scheduling and dispatch it is treated as a separate storage element.
The owner may sell, lease or rent storage capacity, in whole or part, to any consumer, generation, transmission or distribution utility, load despatch centre or any other person.

Rule 18 of the Electricity Rules, 2005 already treats energy storage as part of the power system and makes independent storage a delicensed activity, registered with the Central Electricity Authority.
Under the 2026 captive rules, a captive user includes someone who consumes captive power through a storage system that stored it.

p: Charges for drawing grid power into a consumer battery, and how stored power is billed, come from your state commission's regulations and tariff order. The national framework of August 2023 suggests electricity duty and cross-subsidy surcharge should apply to final consumption rather than charging power, but that is a recommendation to states.

senseible: Senseible records grid units that charge a battery as grid electricity and solar that charges it as solar, so a battery does not change the source of the electricity you report.
